fda612f5: Page 18 (E-1684eeeb...) opens the authors' Conclusions with this exact sentence. It is an evaluative claim about material safety in the authors' own voice and carries no citation. Recording it as NASAConclusion/author_reported_conclusion therefore reports what the authors state without turning it into a measured observation. The judge's case for 'critical' does not hold. The record does not adjudicate whether PTFE is safe, and the same Conclusions paragraph says Brass-filled PTFE 'performs similarly to TFE-Teflon' in high-pressure LOX, so the source contains no contradiction to resolve. The judge's Table 6 reading is the reviewer's own inference. Documentary_context also does not fit. That role covers statements about the document (title, 'this paper will compare', data-source notes, captions), and this sentence is a substantive claim about seat and seal materials. The pipeline also labels uncited author background claims as 'current' (e.g. the page 3 fire-cause sentence). This is not a cited result promoted to a current one, so there is no lineage swap. There are two minor, non-critical defects. The text keeps the stray '18' page number and the 'Conclusions' heading. 'Unknown' lineage would better signal that the claim rests on prior experience rather than this study's data. Neither creates a false scientific record.
ce8e05cc: On page 18, 'The search for a polymer ... has become an ongoing expedition' is narrative framing. It repeats the 'constantly searching for better materials' and 'safari' motif from pages 1 and 3. The pipeline files those earlier sentences as Publication/documentary_context (e.g. proposal-26af50d, proposal-2c7677a). The sentence describes research activity and draws no conclusion from the paper's data, so classing it as NASAConclusion/author_reported_conclusion is a wrong role. The error is not critical. The sentence states no measurement, value, test outcome or comparison result. It does not promote cited or historical data to current findings, and it does not touch any of the known source conflicts (table inconsistencies, the 0/80 vs 4/80 LOX contradiction, unknown Brass fraction, mixed ASTM/MAPTIS/MSFC rows). The misclassification adds noise to the conclusions set but does not mislead about the science.
